title: Identity & Key-control Acceptance Roadmap + Rollout Checklist
creator: Aisha Raman
description: This ticket consolidates the product acceptance criteria, sign-off checklist, and rollout constraints for identity (SSO/SAML), authorization (RBAC), audit logging, and key management (KMS/HSM) across Private and VPC deployments. It captures explicit test cases, operational runbook expectations, rollout gating, and a rollback plan to minimize customer exposure for regulated customers. The goal is to produce a single source of truth for PM, Security, Eng, and Compliance to sign off prior to GA for private-mode customers.
acceptance_criteria: SSO/SAML: Support for SAML 2.0 IdP metadata ingestion; SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows validated with test IdPs (Okta, Azure AD); mapping of SAML attributes into Redwood identity model documented and verified
RBAC: Role matrix defined for Admin/Operator/Observer/Service accounts; enforcement tested against API endpoints and Console UI; org-level and project-level scoping verified

Audit Logs: Every auth decision (login, token issue, key access), admin change, and model-serving access must be recorded in append-only logs with RFC3339 timestamps; logs forwarded to customer-configured syslog/CloudWatch/ELK with configurable retention

KMS/HSM: Envelope encryption for customer-provided keys supported; KMS integration written for AWS KMS and HashiCorp Vault (transit); HSM attestation checklist and API-compatible key wrapping flows verified

Key Rotation & Escrow: Live key-rotation exercise documented and executed end-to-end with no availability loss; key escrow process and emergency-rotation runbook validated with 3rd-party legal requirements
E2E Tests: Automated integration tests for SAML login, RBAC enforcement, audit ingestion, and KMS operations pass in isolated infra; test harness included in release pipeline
PenTest & Vulnerability Scan: Critical findings from security scan remediated or accepted with mitigation plan prior to sign-off

Operational SLOs: Access-related latency (auth token issuance) < 200ms p95, audit log delivery to customer endpoint < 30s p95, and key-encrypt/decrypt latency < 50ms p95 for targeted hardware profiles
Compatibility: Private deployment must be able to run with both native Redwood control plane and customer-managed control plane flavors; difference matrix and compatibility notes included
Documentation: Console UI flows, API field-level docs, and runbook for incident response and key compromise are published and linked in the PRD
signoff_checklist: PM: Product acceptance of the criteria and customer-facing docs
Security: Threat model review completed and high-risk items mitigated
Infrastructure Eng: KMS and network integration validated in staging
Runtime Eng: RBAC enforcement and SSO hooks integrated into serving runtime
SRE: Observability dashboards and alerting configured (auth, key, audit paths)
Compliance: Retention/forensics checklist validated against SOC2/GDPR requirements
Legal: Contract language for customer key custody and incident notification reviewed
PenTest: Critical/High vulnerabilities remediated or acceptance recorded
HSM Attestation: Attestation artifacts collected and stored
Audit Delivery: Successful test delivery to sample customer endpoint (syslog/HTTPS/S3)
Key Rotation Drill: Live rotation executed without service disruption
Final Exec Review: CISO or delegate signs off on go/no-go

decision_log: Decided to prioritize envelope encryption with server-side KMS integration over offering a local-native key store in GA to reduce attack surface and complexity
Chose SAML 2.0 as the primary identity federation method for GA; OIDC deferred to next phase because of current SSO tooling across enterprise customers
Adopted an opt-in escrow policy: customers may opt into key escrow for support-only use cases. Escrow process requires legal sign-off and KMS audit logs
rollback_plan: If an issue in key access or audit delivery is detected in canary, automatically revert traffic to hosted service variant for affected orgs, revoke any newly issued tokens, and rotate service keys used in the failed deployment. Run the emergency key-rotation runbook and notify customers per legal notification timelines.
qa_test_plan: Automated SAML assertion test matrix covering IdP types (Okta/Azure/Generic)
RBAC matrix tests for API endpoints and console UI (admin/operator/observer)
Audit log ingestion and retention verification across all customer endpoint types
KMS wrap/unwrap functional tests including HSM attestation simulation
Fault-injection tests for key-rotation and KMS unavailability scenarios
